title: A PE inspector

milestone.title: Ground Rules, Tools and the PE Format

hints: Keep the file's bytes in the object and write three private helpers: read an `n`-byte number at a file offset, find the section containing an RVA, and read a zero-terminated string at an RVA (returning `std::nullopt` if the RVA has no file offset). Everything else is built from them.
The import directory's RVA is the first data directory after the export one: data directories start at offset 112 of the optional header, 8 bytes each, so entry 1 is at 120.
requirements: Invalid or truncated files are rejected without reading out of bounds.
Sections, RVA conversion and permissions are reported correctly.
Imports by name and by ordinal are listed per DLL, in file order.
Descriptors whose import name table is missing fall back to the import address table.
stretch: Add `exports()` for DLLs, reusing your lookup code from lesson 1.04 but working on file offsets, and print a summary in the style of `dumpbin /imports`.
